newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Energy ministers agree on Energy Charter Treaty.
newsitem.headline: Energy ministers agree on Energy Charter Treaty.

text.p: The Energy Council reached a political agreement on Tuesday on the draft decision on the conclusion of the Energy Charter Treaty.
The treaty commits all signatories to cooperate and to provide a legal framework for investments, trade and transit in the energy sector.
The agreed text will be sent to the European Parliament for its assent and is expected to be finally adopted by the Council later.
The conclusion of the treaty by the EU and its member states has been slowed down by legal complexities.

The Energy Charter Treaty and the Energy Charter Protocol on Energy Efficiency and Related Environmental Aspects have been signed by 50 countries plus the EU, but the United States and Canada have not signed.
Most EU countries hope to finalise their ratification processes by early next year.
The treaty is mainly aimed at stimulating investment by the West in the energy sector in Eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union to facilitate their transition to market economies.
